<select id="selectIncoming" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.commerce.dal.dataobject.executionorder.CrmExecutionOrderDO">
        SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND source_system = #{query.sourceSystem}
        <choose>
            <when test="query.executionNumbers != null and !query.executionNumbers.isEmpty()">
                AND execution_no IN
                <foreach collection="query.executionNumbers" item="number" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{number}</foreach>
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1 = 0</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectActiveByExecutionNos" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.commerce.dal.dataobject.executionorder.CrmExecutionOrderDO">
        SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
          <choose>
              <when test="query.executionNos != null and !query.executionNos.isEmpty()">
                  AND execution_no IN
                  <foreach collection="query.executionNos" item="number" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{number}</foreach>
              </when>
              <otherwise>AND 1 = 0</otherwise>
          </choose>
        ORDER BY submit_time DESC, id DESC
    </select>

<update id="updatePrimaryProjectIfUnbound">
        UPDATE com_crm_execution_order
        SET primary_project_id = #{query.projectId}, updater = #{query.updater},
            update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND CAST(company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.companyCode} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(execution_no AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.executionNo} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(source_system AS BINARY) = CAST(#{query.sourceSystem} AS BINARY)
          <if test="query.companyId != null">AND company_id = #{query.companyId}</if>
          AND (primary_project_id IS NULL OR primary_project_id = #{query.projectId})
    </update>

<select id="selectActiveForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.commerce.dal.dataobject.executionorder.CrmExecutionOrderDO">
        SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
          <choose>
              <when test="query.executionNos != null and !query.executionNos.isEmpty()">
                  AND execution_no IN
                  <foreach collection="query.executionNos" item="number" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{number}</foreach>
              </when>
              <otherwise>AND 1 = 0</otherwise>
          </choose>
        ORDER BY submit_time DESC, id DESC
        FOR UPDATE
    </select>
